data.desc: NUBURU, Inc. is developing a dual-use Defense & Security integrated platform combining operating businesses and technology-development initiatives. Following completion of its acquisition of a 70% controlling interest in Tekne S.p.A. on October 15, 2026, the group brings together Tekne's electronic-warfare and special-vehicle capabilities, Lyocon's laser and photonics engineering, and Orbit's operational-resilience software. NUBURU is focused on integration and commercial execution across defense, security, critical-infrastructure and digital-resilience markets. New integrated capabilities remain subject to technical validation, customer requirements and applicable approvals.
